facts.label: Rotina e frequência
facts.sub: Coloque always, usually, often, sometimes ou never antes do verbo principal: I usually start at seven. I never work at night.

facts.label: Frequência
facts.sub: Os advérbios de frequência dizem quantas vezes algo acontece: always (sempre), usually (geralmente), often (muitas vezes), sometimes (às vezes), never (nunca). Use-os para falar da rotina.

facts.label: Posição
facts.sub: Coloque o advérbio antes do verbo: I always check. Mas depois do verbo to be: She is always kind. Essa é a regra mais importante do assunto.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We say “I start usually at seven”.
items.why: We say I usually start at seven.

items.s: Never is used with a negative verb.
items.why: Never already means no. We say I never work.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Always means 100% of the time. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I start usually at seven”. → Falso (We say I usually start at seven.)
Never is used with a negative verb. → Falso (Never already means no. We say I never work.)

pages.title: A small clinic · 1/3
paragraphs: It is seven o’clock on a cold morning in Toronto. Snow covers the street outside the clinic. Nina wears a blue uniform. Her friend Xavier waits with two cups of tea. He walks with her to the door. He asks about her day.
“Hi, Nina! What time do you start work?” says Xavier. “I usually start at seven in the morning.” says Nina. “Do you always eat breakfast first?” says Xavier.
